notes.title: Hello everyone, I'm delighted to share some news with you.
notes.content: [p]We have changed the game to a paid system. You only need to spend a small amount of money to purchase the game, and you will gain access to unlimited in-game resources. All spirit stones are completely free! We hope everyone enjoys the game![/p]

notes.title: Regrettably, we are about to switch the game from free to paid.
notes.content:
Hello everyone! It has been over a month since our game was released on Steam, and we were surprised by the cautious attitude of players towards free games. Unfortunately, we are a small studio developer just starting out and currently don't have the opportunity to monetize a free game. So we will switch to a paid model to boost revenue and ensure the development of our future games.
We expect to complete the change by June 2025 and the game will be available at a very low price. Players who have purchased in-game items can apply for a refund. We apologize for any inconvenience caused.
